AUTHORIZED_OPERATIONS = %w[benchmark aggregate prepare-scoring score].freeze\n    DOWNSTREAM_OPERATIONS = %w[aggregate prepare-scoring score].freeze\n\n    attr_reader :path, :data, :digest, :records\n\n    def self.path_for(run_dir)\n      File.join(File.expand_path(run_dir), FILENAME)\n    end\n\n    def self.digest_for(run_dir)\n      path = path_for(run_dir)\n      File.file?(path) ? def self.create!(manifest:, correction_dir:, reason:, dry_run: false,\n                     scope: \"exact\", revision_mode: \"transition\")\n      raise \"Unknown correction scope\" unless %w[exact manifest].include?(scope)\n      raise \"Unknown correction revision mode\" unless %w[transition already_corrected].include?(revision_mode)\n      run_dir = File.dirname(manifest.path)\n      paths = reason.empty?\n      correction_dir = File.realpath(correction_dir)\n      source_manifest_path = File.join(correction_dir, \"manifest.yaml\")\n      source_records_path = File.join(correction_dir, \"corrections.jsonl\")\n      source_ids_path = File.join(correction_dir, \"correction-ids.txt\")\n      [source_manifest_path, source_records_path, source_ids_path].each do |path|\n        raise evidence.dig(\"original_source\", \"root\") == recorded.fetch(\"path\") &&\n             evidence.dig(pinned_kind, \"commit\") == recorded.fetch(\"commit\")\n        raise \"Correction evidence does corrected.fetch(\"commit\"), scope: scope)\n      if scope == \"manifest\" || revision_mode == \"already_corrected\"\n        verify_record_trees!(records, recorded.fetch(\"path\"), original_commit, |record| record.fetch(\"changed_paths\") }.uniq.sort\n      raise \"Corrected Git commit path set differs from correction records\" unless changed_paths == expected_paths\n\n      data = {\n        \"schema_version\" => SCHEMA_VERSION,\n        \"created_at\" => Time.now.iso8601,\n        \"manifest_sha256\" => LocalEvaluation.sha256_file(manifest.path),\n        \"reason\" => reason,\n        \"authorized_operations\" => AUTHORIZED_OPERATIONS,\n        \"affected_run_ids\" => affected_ids,\n        \"correction_scope\" => scope,\n        \"source_revision_mode\" => revision_mode,\n        \"manifest_experiment_repository\" => recorded,\n        \"original_experiment_repository\" => recorded.merge(\"commit\" => original_commit),\n        \"corrected_experiment_repository\" => corrected,\n        \"changed_paths_count\" => changed_paths.size,\n        \"changed_paths_sha256\" => Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(changed_paths.join(\"\\n\") + \"\\n\"),\n        \"source_evidence_path\" => correction_dir,\n        \"source_evidence_manifest_sha256\" => LocalEvaluation.sha256_file(source_manifest_path),\n        \"records_file\" => RECORDS_FILENAME,\n        \"records_sha256\" => LocalEvaluation.sha256_file(source_records_path),\n        \"ids_file\" => IDS_FILENAME,\n        \"ids_sha256\" => LocalEvaluation.sha256_file(source_ids_path),\n        \"evidence_file\" => EVIDENCE_FILENAME\n      }\n      return data if dry_run\n\n      write_immutable(paths.fetch(:records), File.binread(source_records_path))\n      write_immutable(paths.fetch(:ids), File.binread(source_ids_path))\n      write_immutable(paths.fetch(:evidence), File.binread(source_manifest_path))\n      LocalEvaluation.atomic_yaml_with_digest(paths.fetch(:amendment), data, immutable: true)\n      new(paths.fetch(:amendment), manifest: manifest)\n    end\n\n    def self.artifact_paths(run_dir)\n      run_dir = File.expand_path(run_dir)\n      {\n        amendment: File.join(run_dir, FILENAME),\n        records: File.join(run_dir, RECORDS_FILENAME),\n        ids: File.join(run_dir, IDS_FILENAME),\n        evidence: File.join(run_dir, EVIDENCE_FILENAME)\n      }\n    end\n    private_class_method :artifact_paths\n\n    def self.write_immutable(path, content)\n      digest = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(content)\n      LocalEvaluation.atomic_write(\"#{path}.sha256\", \"#{digest}\\n\", mode: 0o444)\n      LocalEvaluation.fsync_directory(File.dirname(path))\n      LocalEvaluation.atomic_write(path, content, mode: 0o444)\n      LocalEvaluation.fsync_directory(File.dirname(path))\n    end\n    private_class_method :write_immutable\n\n    def self.parse_jsonl(path)\n      File.foreach(path, chomp: true).filter_map do |line|\n        JSON.parse(line) unless line.empty?\n      end\n    rescue JSON::ParserError => e\n      raise \"Malformed correction JSONL #{path}: #{e.message}\"\n    end\n    private_class_method :parse_jsonl\n\n    def self.validate_external_evidence!(evidence, records, ids, records_path, ids_path)\n      unless evidence.is_a?(Hash) && evidence[\"schema_version\"] == SCHEMA_VERSION &&\n             evidence[\"record_count\"] == records.size && evidence[\"all_final_verdicts\"] == \"accept\"\n        raise \"Correction evidence manifest is malformed or incomplete\"\n      end\n      unless evidence.dig(\"artifacts\", \"corrections_jsonl_sha256\") == LocalEvaluation.sha256_file(records_path) &&\n             evidence.dig(\"artifacts\", \"correction_ids_sha256\") == LocalEvaluation.sha256_file(ids_path)\n        raise \"Correction evidence artifact digest mismatch\"\n      end\n      record_ids = records.map { |record| record.fetch(\"program_id\") }\n      unless ids == ids.uniq.sort && ids == record_ids.sort && ids.size == records.size\n        raise \"Correction ID list and records are inconsistent\"\n      end\n      compile = evidence.fetch(\"compile_validation\")\n      unless compile[\"records\"] == records.size && compile[\"compiled\"] == records.size &&\n             compile[\"compile_successes\"] == records.size && compile[\"compile_failures\"] == []\n        raise \"Correction evidence does not record a successful static compilation of every correction\"\n      end\n    end\n    private_class_method :validate_external_evidence!\n\n    def self.validate_records!(records, ids, manifest, original_commit, corrected_commit)\n      mapped = records.to_h { |record| [record.fetch(\"program_id\"), record] }\n      raise \"Correction records contain duplicate program IDs\" unless mapped.size == records.size\n      ids.each do |id|\n        record = mapped.fetch(id)\n        info = manifest.runs[id]\n        raise \"Correction record is absent from the run manifest: #{id}\" unless info\n        expected_prefix = [info.fetch(\"batch\"), id].join(\"/\")\n        identity = %w[benchmark model par_type run].all? { |key| record[key] == info[key] }\n        unless identity && record[\"source_prefix\"] == expected_prefix && record[\"source_batch\"] == info[\"batch\"]\n          raise \"Correction record identity differs from the run manifest for #{id}\"\n        end\n        unless record[\"timing_fixed\"] == true && record[\"final_verdict\"] == \"accept\" &&\n               record.dig(\"original_source\", \"commit\") == original_commit &&\n               record.dig(\"corrected_source\", \"commit\") == corrected_commit\n          raise \"Correction record lacks accepted timing-only revision provenance for #{id}\"\n        end\n        paths = record[\"changed_paths\"]\n        unless paths.is_a?(Array) && !paths.empty? && paths == paths.uniq.sort &&\n               paths.all? { |path| path.start_with?(\"#{expected_prefix}/\") }\n          raise \"Correction record has an invalid changed-path set for #{id}\"\n        end\n      end\n    end\n    private_class_method :validate_records!\n\n    # A single reviewed source commit can serve more than one evaluation batch.\n    # Retain the complete registry/path proof, but authorize only IDs in this run.\n    def self.validate_scoped_records!(records, ids, manifest, original_commit, corrected_commit, scope:)\n      raise \"Unknown correction scope\" unless %w[exact manifest].include?(scope)\n      affected = ids & manifest.runs.keys\n      raise \"No corrections belong to this run manifest\" if affected.empty?\n      outside = ids - affected\n      if scope == \"exact\" && !outside.empty?\n        raise \"Correction record is absent from the run manifest: #{outside.first}\"\n      end\n      expanded = manifest.runs.dup\n      records.each do |record|\n        id = record.fetch(\"program_id\")\n        next if expanded.key?(id)\n        batch = record.fetch(\"source_batch\")\n        raise \"Invalid external correction batch\" unless batch.match?(/\\A\\d{8}-\\d{6}\\z/)\n        expanded[id] = LocalEvaluation.parse_run_id(id).merge(\"batch\" => batch)\n      end\n      validate_records!(records, ids, Struct.new(:runs).new(expanded), original_commit, corrected_commit)\n      affected.sort\n    end\n    private_class_method :validate_scoped_records!\n\n    def self.verify_record_trees!(records, root, original_commit, corrected_commit)\n      records.each do |record|\n        %w[original corrected].zip([original_commit, corrected_commit]).each do |kind, commit|\n          prefix = record.fetch(\"source_prefix\")\n          output, error, status = Open3.capture3(\"git\", \"-C\", root, \"rev-parse\", \"#{commit}:#{prefix}\")\n          unless status.success? && output.strip == record.dig(\"#{kind}_source\", \"tree_oid\")\n            raise \"Correction #{kind} source tree differs for #{record.fetch('program_id')}: #{error.strip}\"\n          end\n        end\n      end\n    end\n    private_class_method :verify_record_trees!\n\n    def self.git_changed_paths(root, original, corrected)\n      stdout, stderr, status = Open3.capture3(\"git\", \"-C\", root, \"diff\", \"--name-only\", original, corrected, \"--\")\n      raise \"Could not inspect corrected Git path set: #{stderr.strip}\" unless status.success?\n      stdout.lines(chomp: true).sort\n    end\n    private_class_method :git_changed_paths\n\n    def initialize(path, manifest:)\n      @path = File.expand_path(path)\n      verify_digest_pair!(@path, \"Source correction amendment\")\n      @digest = LocalEvaluation.sha256_file(@path)\n      @data = LocalEvaluation.load_yaml(@path)\n      unless @data.is_a?(Hash) && @data[\"schema_version\"] == SCHEMA_VERSION &&\n             @data[\"manifest_sha256\"] == LocalEvaluation.sha256_file(manifest.path)\n        raise \"Source correction amendment is malformed or belongs to another manifest\"\n      end\n      unless @data[\"authorized_operations\"] == AUTHORIZED_OPERATIONS\n        raise \"Source correction amendment has an invalid authorized-operation set\"\n      end\n      paths = self.class.send(:artifact_paths, File.dirname(@path))\n      [paths.fetch(:records), paths.fetch(:ids), paths.fetch(:evidence)].each do |artifact|\n        verify_digest_pair!(artifact, \"Source correction artifact\")\n      end\n      unless @data[\"records_sha256\"] == LocalEvaluation.sha256_file(paths.fetch(:records)) &&\n             @data[\"ids_sha256\"] == LocalEvaluation.sha256_file(paths.fetch(:ids)) &&\n             @data[\"source_evidence_manifest_sha256\"] == LocalEvaluation.sha256_file(paths.fetch(:evidence))\n        raise \"Source correction amendment artifact binding is inconsistent\"\n      end\n      @records = self.class.send(:parse_jsonl, paths.fetch(:records)).to_h do |record|\n        [record.fetch(\"program_id\"), record]\n @data.fetch(\"corrected_experiment_repository\").fetch(\"commit\")\n      scope = @data.fetch(\"correction_scope\", \"exact\")\n      mode = @data.fetch(\"source_revision_mode\", \"transition\")\n manifest.data.dig(\"experiment_repository\", \"commit\") == expected_manifest_commit\n        raise \"Correction revision mode differs from the run manifest\"\n      end\n      affected = self.class.send(:validate_scoped_records!, @records.values, ids, manifest, original, corrected, scope: scope)\n      unless affected == @data[\"affected_run_ids\"] && ids == @records.keys.sort\n        raise \"Source correction amendment affected-run set is inconsistent\"\n      end\n    end\n\n    def affected_ids\n      @data.fetch(\"affected_run_ids\")\n    end\n\n    def record_for(id)\n      @records[id] if affected_ids.include?(id)\n    end\n\n    def verify_record_source!(id)\n      record = @records.fetch(id)\n      repository = @data.fetch(\"corrected_experiment_repository\")\n      root = repository.fetch(\"path\")\n      commit = repository.fetch(\"commit\")\n      prefix = record.fetch(\"source_prefix\")\n      stdout, stderr, status = Open3.capture3(\"git\", \"-C\", root, \"rev-parse\", \"HEAD\", \"HEAD:#{prefix}\")\n      raise InfrastructureError, \"Could not verify corrected source for #{id}: #{stderr.strip}\" unless status.success?\n      head, tree = stdout.lines(chomp: true)\n      unless head == commit && tree == record.dig(\"corrected_source\", \"tree_oid\")\n        raise InfrastructureError, \"Corrected source revision changed before benchmarking #{id}\"\n      end\n      status_text, status_error, status = Open3.capture3(\n        \"git\", \"-C\", root, \"status\", \"--porcelain=v1\", \"--untracked-files=all\", \"--\", prefix\n      )\n      unless status.success? && status_text.empty?\n        detail = status.success? ? status_text.strip : status_error.strip\n        raise InfrastructureError, \"Corrected source is dirty for #{id}: #{detail}\"\n      end\n      true\n    end\n\n    def verify!(manifest:, operation:, exact_id:, filter:, selected_ids: nil)\n      recorded = @data.fetch(\"corrected_experiment_repository\")\n      current = LocalEvaluation.git_snapshot(recorded.fetch(\"path\"))\n      unless current[\"git\"] && current[\"commit\"] == recorded[\"commit\"] && !current[\"dirty\"]\n        raise InfrastructureError,\n              \"Experiment repository differs from the immutable source correction amendment\"\n      end\n      changed = self.class.send(\n        :git_changed_paths, recorded.fetch(\"path\"),\n        @data.fetch(\"original_experiment_repository\").fetch(\"commit\"), recorded.fetch(\"commit\")\n      )\n      expected_digest = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(changed.join(\"\\n\") + \"\\n\")\n      unless changed.size == @data[\"changed_paths_count\"] && expected_digest == @data[\"changed_paths_sha256\"]\n        raise InfrastructureError, \"Corrected experiment commit path set differs from the immutable amendment\"\n      end\n\n      return true if operation.nil?\n      operation = operation.to_s\n      unless AUTHORIZED_OPERATIONS.include?(operation)\n        raise InfrastructureError, \"Source correction amendment does not authorize #{operation}\"\n      end\n      selection = Array(selected_ids).map(&:to_s)\n      selection = [exact_id] if selection.empty? && exact_id\n      if operation == \"benchmark\"\n        unless filter.nil? && !selection.empty? && selection.uniq.size == selection.size &&\n               (selection - affected_ids).empty?\n          raise InfrastructureError,\n                \"Corrected sources may benchmark only an explicit subset of timing-correction IDs\"\n        end\n      elsif exact_id || filter || !selection.empty?\n        raise InfrastructureError,\n              \"Corrected-source downstream #{operation} must rebuild the full corpus without selection\"\n      end\n      true\n    end\n\n    private\n\n    def verify_digest_pair!(path, label)\n      sidecar = \"#{path}.sha256\"\n      raise \"#{label} digest sidecar is missing: #{sidecar}\" unless File.file?(sidecar)\n      expected = File.read(sidecar).strip\n      unless expected.match?(/\\A[0-9a-f]{64}\\z/) && expected == LocalEvaluation.sha256_file(path)\n        raise \"#{label} digest mismatch: #{path}\"\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  class PipelineAmendment\n    FILENAME = \"pipeline_amendment.yaml\"\n    SEQUENCED_FILENAME_RE = /\\Apipeline_amendment\\.(?<sequence>\\d+)\\.yaml\\z/\n    AUTHORIZED_OPERATIONS = %w[benchmark aggregate prepare-scoring score].freeze\n    DOWNSTREAM_OPERATIONS = %w[aggregate prepare-scoring score].freeze\n\n    attr_reader :path, :data, :digest\n\n    def self.base_path_for(run_dir)\n      File.join(File.expand_path(run_dir), FILENAME)\n    end\n\n    def self.paths_for(run_dir)\n      run_dir = File.expand_path(run_dir)\n      base = base_path_for(run_dir)\n      numbered = if File.directory?(run_dir)\n        Dir.children(run_dir).filter_map do |entry|\n          match = SEQUENCED_FILENAME_RE.match(entry)\n          [Integer(match[:sequence], 10), File.join(run_dir, entry)] if match\n        end.sort_by(&:first).map(&:last)\n      else\n        []\n      end\n      [*(File.file?(base) ? [base] : []), *numbered]\n    end\n\n    def self.path_for(run_dir)\n      paths_for(run_dir).last || base_path_for(run_dir)\n    end\n\n    def self.digest_for(run_dir)\n      path = path_for(run_dir)\n      File.file?(path) ? LocalEvaluation.sha256_file(path) : nil\n    end\n\n    def self.load_chain(run_dir, manifest:)\n      prior = nil\n      paths_for(run_dir).map do |path|\n        prior = new(path, manifest: manifest, prior: prior)\n      end\n    end\n\n    def self.create!(manifest:, affected_ids:, reason:, dry_run: false)\n      run_dir = File.dirname(manifest.path)\n      chain = load_chain(run_dir, manifest: manifest)\n      prior = chain.last\n      sequence = chain.size + 1\n      path = sequence == 1 ? base_path_for(run_dir) : File.join(run_dir, \"pipeline_amendment.#{sequence}.yaml\")\n      raise \"Pipeline amendment already exists and is immutable: #{path}\" if File.exist?(path)\n\n      reason = reason.to_s.strip\n      raise \"Pipeline amendment reason must not be empty\" if reason.empty?\n\n      affected_ids = [*Array(prior&.data&.fetch(\"affected_run_ids\", nil)), *Array(affected_ids)]\n                     .map(&:to_s).uniq.sort\n      raise \"Pipeline amendment must name at least one affected run ID\" if affected_ids.empty?\n      unknown = affected_ids - manifest.runs.keys\n      unless unknown.empty?\n        raise \"Pipeline amendment contains IDs absent from the manifest: #{unknown.join(', ')}\"\n      end\n\n      manifest.verify_non_pipeline_input_revisions!\n      original = prior ? prior.data.fetch(\"amended_pipeline_source\") : manifest.data.fetch(\"pipeline_source\")\n      current = LocalEvaluation.pipeline_source_snapshot(manifest.data.fetch(\"pipeline_source\").fetch(\"root\"))\n      if current[\"sha256\"] == original[\"sha256\"]\n        raise \"Pipeline source has not changed; no amendment is needed\"\n      end\n\n      changed_files = changed_file_map(original.fetch(\"files\"), current.fetch(\"files\"))\n      data = {\n        \"schema_version\" => SCHEMA_VERSION,\n        \"created_at\" => Time.now.iso8601,\n        \"sequence\" => sequence,\n        \"prior_amendment_sha256\" => prior&.digest,\n        \"manifest_sha256\" => LocalEvaluation.sha256_file(manifest.path),\n        \"reason\" => reason,\n        \"affected_run_ids\" => affected_ids,\n        \"authorized_operations\" => AUTHORIZED_OPERATIONS,\n        \"original_pipeline_source_sha256\" => original.fetch(\"sha256\"),\n        \"amended_pipeline_source\" => current,\n        \"changed_files\" => changed_files\n      }\n      return data if dry_run\n\n      LocalEvaluation.atomic_yaml_with_digest(path, data, immutable: true)\n      new(path, manifest: manifest, prior: prior)\n    end\n\n    def self.changed_file_map(original_files, amended_files)\n      (original_files.keys | amended_files.keys).sort.each_with_object({}) do |relative, changed|\n        before = original_files[relative]\n        after = amended_files[relative]\n        next if before == after\n\n        changed[relative] = { \"before_sha256\" => before, \"after_sha256\" => after }\n      end\n    end\n    private_class_method :changed_file_map\n\n    def initialize(path, manifest:, prior: nil)\n      @path = File.expand_path(path)\n      sidecar = \"#{@path}.sha256\"\n      raise \"Pipeline amendment digest sidecar is missing: #{sidecar}\" unless File.file?(sidecar)\n      expected = File.read(sidecar).strip\n      unless expected.match?(/\\A[0-9a-f]{64}\\z/)\n        raise \"Pipeline amendment digest sidecar is malformed: #{sidecar}\"\n      end\n      @digest = LocalEvaluation.sha256_file(@path)\n      raise \"Pipeline amendment digest mismatch: #{@path}\" unless expected == @digest\n\n      @data = LocalEvaluation.load_yaml(@path)\n      unless @data.is_a?(Hash) && @data[\"schema_version\"] == SCHEMA_VERSION\n        raise \"Unsupported pipeline amendment schema in #{@path}\"\n      end\n      unless @data[\"manifest_sha256\"] == LocalEvaluation.sha256_file(manifest.path)\n        raise \"Pipeline amendment belongs to another manifest\"\n      end\n      expected_sequence = prior ? prior.data.fetch(\"sequence\", 1) + 1 : 1\n      unless @data.fetch(\"sequence\", 1) == expected_sequence\n        raise \"Pipeline amendment sequence is not contiguous\"\n      end\n      unless @data[\"prior_amendment_sha256\"] == prior&.digest\n        raise \"Pipeline amendment does not bind its predecessor\"\n      end\n      original = prior ? prior.data.fetch(\"amended_pipeline_source\") : manifest.data.fetch(\"pipeline_source\")\n      unless @data[\"original_pipeline_source_sha256\"] == original[\"sha256\"]\n        raise \"Pipeline amendment does not start from its recorded predecessor source\"\n      end\n      unless @data[\"authorized_operations\"] == AUTHORIZED_OPERATIONS\n        raise \"Pipeline amendment has an invalid authorized-operation set\"\n      end\n      reason = @data[\"reason\"]\n      raise \"Pipeline amendment reason must not be empty\" unless reason.is_a?(String) && !reason.strip.empty?\n\n      affected = @data[\"affected_run_ids\"]\n      unless affected.is_a?(Array) && !affected.empty? && affected == affected.uniq.sort &&\n             affected.all? { |id| id.is_a?(String) && manifest.runs.key?(id) }\n        raise \"Pipeline amendment has an invalid affected-run set\"\n      end\n      if prior && (prior.data.fetch(\"affected_run_ids\") - affected).any?\n        raise \"Pipeline amendment drops a previously affected run ID\"\n      end\n      amended = @data[\"amended_pipeline_source\"]\n      unless amended.is_a?(Hash) && amended[\"files\"].is_a?(Hash)\n        raise \"Pipeline amendment has no valid amended source snapshot\"\n      end\n      unless amended[\"root\"] == manifest.data.fetch(\"pipeline_source\").fetch(\"root\")\n        raise \"Pipeline amendment source root differs from the manifest\"\n      end\n      aggregate = Digest::SHA256.new\n      amended.fetch(\"files\").sort.each { |relative, digest| aggregate << relative << \"\\0\" << digest << \"\\0\" }\n      unless amended[\"sha256\"] == aggregate.hexdigest\n        raise \"Pipeline amendment source snapshot digest is inconsistent\"\n      end\n      expected_changes = self.class.send(:changed_file_map, original.fetch(\"files\"), amended.fetch(\"files\"))\n      unless @data[\"changed_files\"] == expected_changes && !expected_changes.empty?\n        raise \"Pipeline amendment changed-file map is inconsistent\"\n      end\n    end\n\n    def verify!(manifest:, current_pipeline:, operation:, exact_id:, filter:, selected_ids: nil)\n      unless @data[\"amended_pipeline_source\"] == current_pipeline\n        raise InfrastructureError,\n              \"Local evaluation pipeline source differs from the immutable amendment \" \\\n              \"(expected #{@data.dig('amended_pipeline_source', 'sha256')}, got #{current_pipeline['sha256']})\"\n      end\n\n      operation = operation.to_s\n      unless AUTHORIZED_OPERATIONS.include?(operation)\n        raise InfrastructureError,\n              \"Pipeline amendment does not authorize #{operation.empty? ? 'this operation' : operation}\"\n      end\n      if operation == \"benchmark\"\n        selection = Array(selected_ids).map(&:to_s)\n        selection = [exact_id] if selection.empty? && exact_id\n        unless filter.nil? && !selection.empty? && selection.uniq.size == selection.size &&\n               (selection - @data.fetch(\"affected_run_ids\")).empty?\n          raise InfrastructureError,\n \"#{benchmark}_#{par_type}\", id)\n        warm_prefix = File.join(directory, \"probe_#{probe_index}_warmup\")\n        warmup = run_with_budget(command, env, warm_prefix, executable, deadline)\n        unless warmup\n          failures[id] = \"cell_budget_exhausted\"\n          break\n        end\n        walls << warmup.wall_seconds\n        unless warmup.success\n          failures[id] = execution_failure(warmup)\n          next\n        end\n\n        times = []\n        pilot_walls = []\n        measurement_count.times do |index|\n          prefix = File.join(directory, \"probe_#{probe_index}_#{index}\")\n          result = run_with_budget(command, env, prefix, executable, deadline)\n          unless result\n            failures[id] = \"cell_budget_exhausted\"\n            break\n          end\n          walls << result.wall_seconds\n          pilot_walls << result.wall_seconds\n          unless result.success\n            failures[id] = execution_failure(result)\n            break\n          end\n          begin\n            metrics = BenchmarkMetrics.parse(benchmark, File.read(\"#{prefix}_stdout.log\"))\n            times << metrics.fetch(\"time\") / 1000.0\n          rescue StandardError => e\n            LocalEvaluation.atomic_write(\"#{prefix}_parse_error.log\", \"#{e.class}: #{e.message}\\n\")\n            failures[id] = \"parse_error\"\n            break\n          end\n        end\n        if times.size == measurement_count\n          medians[id] = BenchmarkMetrics.median(times)\n          wall_medians[id] = BenchmarkMetrics.median(pilot_walls)\n        end\n      end\n      fastest_id = medians.min_by { |_id, seconds| seconds }&.first\n      {\n        \"probe\" => probe_index,\n        \"args\" => args,\n        \"pilot_median_seconds\" => medians,\n        \"pilot_wall_median_seconds\" => wall_medians,\n        \"fastest_pilot_id\" => fastest_id,\n        \"fastest_median_seconds\" => fastest_id && medians[fastest_id],\n        \"fastest_pilot_wall_median_seconds\" => fastest_id && wall_medians[fastest_id],\n        \"wall_seconds\" => walls,\n        \"failed_pilots\" => failures,\n        \"budget_exhausted\" => monotonic_now >= deadline\n      }\n    end\n\n    def run_with_budget(command, env, prefix, executable, deadline)\n      remaining = deadline - monotonic_now\n      return nil unless remaining.positive?\n      @runner.run(argv: command, env: env, prefix: prefix, timeout: [probe_timeout, remaining].min,\n                  chdir: File.dirname(executable), limits: ExecutionLimits::PERFORMANCE)\n    end\n\n    def execution_failure(result)\n      return \"timeout\" if result.timed_out\n      return \"signal_#{result.term_signal}\" if result.term_signal\n      \"exit_#{result.exit_code}\"\n    end\n\n    def at_upper_cap?(args, scale, par_type)\n      index = args.index(scale.fetch(\"argument\"))\n      Integer(args.fetch(index + 1), 10) >= @rules.scale_maximum(scale, par_type)\n    end\n\n    def scaled_args(args, scale, workload_ratio, par_type = nil)\n      argument = scale.fetch(\"argument\")\n      index = args.index(argument)\n      raise \"Scaling argument #{argument} not found in #{args.inspect}\" unless index && args[index + 1]\n      current = Integer(args[index + 1], 10)\n      exponent = scale.fetch(\"exponent\").to_f\n      proposed = if workload_ratio.finite? && workload_ratio.positive?\n        current * (workload_ratio**(1.0 / exponent))\n      else\n        current\n      end\n      alignment = scale.fetch(\"alignment\").to_i\n      proposed = (proposed / alignment).round * alignment\n      maximum = par_type ? @rules.scale_maximum(scale, par_type) : scale.fetch(\"maximum\").to_i\n      proposed = [[proposed, scale.fetch(\"minimum\").to_i].max, maximum].min\n      updated = args.dup\n      updated[index + 1] = proposed.to_i.to_s\n      updated\n    end\n  end\n\n  class BenchmarkPipeline\n    def self.freeze_config(run_dir:, proposed_path: nil, dry_run: false)\n      run_dir = File.expand_path(run_dir)\n      proposed_path ||= File.join(run_dir, \"benchmark_config.proposed.yaml\")\n      raise \"Proposed configuration not found: #{proposed_path}\" unless File.file?(proposed_path)\n      config = LocalEvaluation.load_yaml(proposed_path)\n      raise \"Unsupported proposed configuration schema\" unless config[\"schema_version\"] == SCHEMA_VERSION\n      raise \"Expected a proposed configuration\" unless config[\"state\"] == \"proposed\"\n      manifest = Manifest.new(run_dir)\n      raise \"Proposed configuration belongs to another manifest\" unless config[\"manifest_sha256\"] == LocalEvaluation.sha256_file(manifest.path)\n      validation_path = File.join(run_dir, \"validation\", \"all_validation_results.yaml\")\n      raise \"Validation results not found: #{validation_path}\" unless File.file?(validation_path)\n      validation = LocalEvaluation.load_yaml(validation_path, permitted_classes: [ValidationResult]) || []\n      validation_ids = validation.map(&:id_string).sort\n      raise \"Validation is incomplete; configuration cannot be frozen\" unless config[\"validation_complete\"] && validation_ids == manifest.runs.keys.sort\n      unless config[\"validation_results_sha256\"] == LocalEvaluation.sha256_file(validation_path)\n        raise \"Validation results changed after calibration; recalibrate before freezing\"\n      end\n      seed_path = config.fetch(\"seed_path\")\n      expected_seed_path = CalibrationSeed.snapshot_path(run_dir)\n      unless File.expand_path(seed_path) == expected_seed_path\n        raise \"Proposed configuration is not bound to the run-owned calibration seed snapshot\"\n      end\n      seed = CalibrationSeed.new(seed_path)\n      raise \"Calibration seed has changed since calibration\" unless config[\"seed_sha256\"] == seed.digest\n      rules = SeedRules.new(seed.data)\n\n      missing = []\n      unresolved = []\n      expected_types = PAR_TYPES.sort\n      actual_types = config.fetch(\"cells\").keys.sort\n      raise \"Proposed configuration has unexpected backend keys: #{actual_types.inspect}\" unless actual_types == expected_types\n      PAR_TYPES.each do |par_type|\n        actual_benchmarks = config.fetch(\"cells\").fetch(par_type).keys.sort\n        unless actual_benchmarks == BENCHMARKS.sort\n          raise \"Proposed configuration has unexpected benchmark keys for #{par_type}: #{actual_benchmarks.inspect}\"\n        end\n        BENCHMARKS.each do |benchmark|\n          cell = config.dig(\"cells\", par_type, benchmark)\n          missing << \"#{benchmark}/#{par_type}\" unless cell\n          next unless cell\n          unresolved << \"#{benchmark}/#{par_type}\" unless cell[\"resolved\"] && RESOLVED_BENCHMARK_STATUSES.include?(cell[\"status\"])\n          rules.validate_args!(par_type, benchmark, cell.fetch(\"args\").map(&:to_s))\n          timeout = Integer(cell.fetch(\"timeout_seconds\").to_s, 10)\n          raise \"Timeout must be between 30 and 120 seconds for #{benchmark}/#{par_type}\" unless timeout.between?(30, 120)\n        end\n      end\n      raise \"Proposed configuration is incomplete: #{missing.join(', ')}\" unless missing.empty?\n      raise \"Review-required calibration cells remain: #{unresolved.join(', ')}\" unless unresolved.empty?\n\n      output = File.join(run_dir, \"benchmark_config.yaml\")\n      digest_path = \"#{output}.sha256\"\n      if File.exist?(output)\n        if File.file?(output) && !File.exist?(digest_path)\n          existing = LocalEvaluation.load_yaml(output)\n          proposed_digest = LocalEvaluation.sha256_file(proposed_path)\n          expected = config.merge(\"state\" => \"frozen\", \"frozen_at\" => existing[\"frozen_at\"],\n                                  \"proposed_sha256\" => proposed_digest)\n          unless existing == expected && existing[\"frozen_at\"].is_a?(String)\n            raise \"Frozen benchmark configuration is missing its digest and cannot be safely recovered: #{output}\"\n          end\n          if dry_run\n            puts \"Freeze dry run: frozen configuration has a safely recoverable missing digest sidecar\"\n            return\n          end\n          digest = LocalEvaluation.sha256_file(output)\n          LocalEvaluation.atomic_write(digest_path, \"#{digest}\\n\")\n          File.chmod(0o444, output)\n          File.chmod(0o444, digest_path)\n          puts \"Recovered frozen benchmark configuration digest at #{digest_path}\"\n          return\n        end\n        # Require the existing pair to be internally consistent before reporting\n        # immutability; a corrupt sidecar must not look like a benign re-freeze.\n        BenchmarkConfig.new(output)\n        raise \"Frozen benchmark configuration already exists and is immutable: #{output}\"\n      end\n      if File.file?(File.join(run_dir, \"benchmark\", BENCHMARK_FULL_RESULTS_FN))\n        raise \"Benchmark results already exist; refusing to replace their configuration\"\n      end\n      if dry_run\n        puts \"Freeze dry run: configuration is complete, reviewed, bounded, and tied to this manifest\"\n        return\n      end\n\n      config[\"state\"] = \"frozen\"\n      config[\"frozen_at\"] = Time.now.iso8601\n      config[\"proposed_sha256\"] = LocalEvaluation.sha256_file(proposed_path)\n      serialized = YAML.dump(config)\n      digest = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(serialized)\n      # The primary file is the commit record. If interrupted after the sidecar,\n      # a retry can safely replace the orphan sidecar and commit the same proposal.\n      LocalEvaluation.atomic_write(digest_path, \"#{digest}\\n\")\n      LocalEvaluation.atomic_write(output, serialized)\n      File.chmod(0o444, output)\n      File.chmod(0o444, digest_path)\n      puts \"Wrote frozen benchmark configuration to #{output} (SHA-256 #{digest})\"\n    end\n\n    def initialize(run_dir:, config_path: nil, exact_id: nil, filter: nil, ids: nil, dry_run: false,\n                   retry_failed: false, runner: ProcessRunner.new, resources: Resources.new)\n      @run_dir = File.expand_path(run_dir)\n      @manifest = Manifest.new(@run_dir)\n      @config = BenchmarkConfig.new(config_path || File.join(@run_dir, \"benchmark_config.yaml\"))\n      raise \"Benchmark configuration must be reviewed and frozen\" unless @config.frozen?\n      @config.validate_cells!\n      unless @config.data[\"manifest_sha256\"] == LocalEvaluation.sha256_file(@manifest.path)\n        raise \"Benchmark configuration belongs to another manifest\"\n      end\n      @selected = @manifest.filtered_runs(exact_id: exact_id, filter: filter, ids: ids)\n      @dry_run = dry_run\n      @retry_failed = retry_failed\n      @runner = runner\n      @resources = resources\n      @benchmark_dir = File.join(@run_dir, \"benchmark\")\n      @results_path = File.join(@benchmark_dir, BENCHMARK_RESULTS_FN)\n      @full_results_path = File.join(@benchmark_dir, BENCHMARK_FULL_RESULTS_FN)\n      @pipeline_amendment = PipelineAmendment.load_chain(@run_dir, manifest: @manifest).last\n      @source_correction = SourceCorrectionAmendment.load(@run_dir, manifest: @manifest)\n      @validation_results = load_validation_results\n      validation_path = File.join(@run_dir, \"validation\", \"all_validation_results.yaml\")\n      unless @config.data[\"validation_results_sha256\"] == LocalEvaluation.sha256_file(validation_path)\n        raise \"Validation results differ from the revision used by the frozen benchmark configuration\"\n      end\n    end\n\n    def run\n      full_results = load_full_results\n      assert_config_consistency!(full_results)\n      candidates = @selected.select { |id, _| @validation_results[id]&.output_comparison }\n      pending = candidates.reject do |id, _|\n        full_results.key?(id) && !(@retry_failed && full_results[id][0] == false)\n      end\n      if @dry_run\n        puts \"Benchmark dry run: #{pending.size} pending fully-valid programs\"\n        pending.each do |id, info|\n          cell = @config.cell(info[\"par_type\"], info[\"benchmark\"])\n          correction = @source_correction&.record_for(id)\n          executable = if correction\n            File.join(\"/tmp\", \"local-evaluation-timing-correction\", id, LocalEvaluation.executable_name(info[\"benchmark\"]))\n          else\n            BuildSupport.find_executable(File.join(@run_dir, \"validation\", id), info[\"benchmark\"])\n          end\n          env, command = @resources.command(par_type: info[\"par_type\"], executable: executable,\n                                            args: cell.fetch(\"args\").map(&:to_s), mode: :benchmark)\n          source = correction ? \"corrected-source local-/tmp-build\" : \"frozen-validation-build\"\n          puts \"#{id}: source=#{source} timeout=#{cell['timeout_seconds']}s env=#{env.inspect} command=#{Shellwords.join(command)}\"\n        end\n        return\n      end\n\n      FileUtils.mkdir_p(@benchmark_dir)\n      LocalEvaluation.ensure_disk_space!(@benchmark_dir)\n      @config.verify_unchanged!\n      record_invocation(pending.size)\n      write_compatibility_results(full_results)\n      if pending.empty?\n        puts \"All selected fully-valid programs already have benchmark results\"\n        return\n      end\n      preflight = @resources.verify_topology!\n      LocalEvaluation.atomic_yaml(File.join(@benchmark_dir, \"preflight.yaml\"),\n                                  preflight.merge(\"checked_at\" => Time.now.iso8601))\n      pending.each do |id, info|\n        @config.verify_unchanged!\n        LocalEvaluation.ensure_disk_space!(@benchmark_dir)\n        puts \"Benchmarking #{id}\"\n        success, metrics = benchmark_one(id, info)\n        full_results[id] = [success, metrics]\n        # Full metrics are the commit record. The boolean compatibility map is derived from it.\n        write_compatibility_results(full_results)\n        puts \"  #{success ? 'passed' : 'failed'}\"\n      end\n    end\n\n    private\n\n    def load_validation_results\n      path = File.join(@run_dir, \"validation\", \"all_validation_results.yaml\")\n      raise \"Validation results not found: #{path}\" unless File.file?(path)\n      array = LocalEvaluation.load_yaml(path, permitted_classes: [ValidationResult]) || []\n      array.to_h { |result| [result.id_string, result] }\n    end\n\n    def load_full_results\n      return {} unless File.file?(@full_results_path)\n      results = LocalEvaluation.load_yaml(@full_results_path) || {}\n      unless results.is_a?(Hash) && results.keys.all? { |id| id.is_a?(String) }\n        raise \"Benchmark full results must be a mapping from string run IDs to result records\"\n      end\n      unknown_ids = results.keys - @manifest.runs.keys\n      unless unknown_ids.empty?\n        raise \"Benchmark results contain IDs absent from the evaluation manifest: #{unknown_ids.sort.join(', ')}\"\n      end\n      results.each_value do |record|\n        # Early local-pipeline runs used an empty array for failures. Normalize\n        # those records to gather_bench_results.rb's historical [false, {}].\n        record[1] = {} if record.is_a?(Array) && record == [false, []]\n      end\n      results.delete_if do |id, record|\n        next false unless @selected.key?(id)\n\n        problem = benchmark_record_problem(id, record)\n        warn \"Requeueing inconsistent benchmark record #{id}: #{problem}\" if problem\n        !problem.nil?\n      end\n      results\n    end\n\n    def benchmark_record_problem(id, record)\n      return \"the frozen validation result is not fully valid\" unless @validation_results[id]&.output_comparison\n\n      valid_success = record.is_a?(Array) && record.size == 2 && record[0] == true &&\n                      record[1].is_a?(Array) && record[1].size == BENCHMARK_COUNT &&\n                      record[1].all? { |metrics| valid_metric_hash?(metrics) }\n      valid_failure = record.is_a?(Array) && record == [false, {}]\n      return \"the canonical result has an invalid shape\" unless valid_success || valid_failure\n\n      metadata_path = File.join(@benchmark_dir, id, \"benchmark_metadata.yaml\")\n      return \"benchmark_metadata.yaml is missing\" unless File.file?(metadata_path)\n      metadata = LocalEvaluation.load_yaml(metadata_path)\n      return \"benchmark_metadata.yaml is not a mapping\" unless metadata.is_a?(Hash)\n\n      info = @manifest.runs.fetch(id)\n      cell = @config.cell(info.fetch(\"par_type\"), info.fetch(\"benchmark\"))\n      expected_args = cell.fetch(\"args\").map(&:to_s)\n      expected_timeout = Integer(cell.fetch(\"timeout_seconds\").to_s, 10)\n      return \"metadata references another run\" unless metadata[\"run\"] == info\n      return \"metadata arguments differ from the frozen configuration\" unless metadata[\"args\"] == expected_args\n      begin\n        actual_timeout = Integer(metadata.fetch(\"timeout_seconds\").to_s, 10)\n      rescue KeyError, ArgumentError\n        return \"metadata timeout is missing or invalid\"\n      end\n      return \"metadata timeout differs from the frozen configuration\" unless actual_timeout == expected_timeout\n      return \"metadata configuration digest differs from the frozen configuration\" unless metadata[\"configuration_sha256\"] == @config.digest\n      if @pipeline_amendment&.data&.fetch(\"affected_run_ids\")&.include?(id) &&\n         metadata[\"pipeline_amendment_sha256\"] != @pipeline_amendment.digest\n        return \"metadata does not bind the scoped pipeline amendment\"\n      end\n      if (correction = @source_correction&.record_for(id))\n        expected = {\n          \"timing_fixed\" => true,\n          \"source_correction_amendment_sha256\" => @source_correction.digest,\n          \"original_source_commit\" => correction.dig(\"original_source\", \"commit\"),\n          \"corrected_source_commit\" => correction.dig(\"corrected_source\", \"commit\"),\n          \"original_source_digest\" => correction.dig(\"original_source\", \"digest\"),\n          \"corrected_source_digest\" => correction.dig(\"corrected_source\", \"digest\"),\n          \"timing_fix_issue_categories\" => correction.fetch(\"original_issue_categories\"),\n          \"timing_fix_changed_paths\" => correction.fetch(\"changed_paths\")\n        }\n        mismatch = expected.find { |key, value| metadata[key] != value }\n        return \"metadata does not bind corrected timing source field #{mismatch[0]}\" if mismatch\n      end\n      return \"metadata success disagrees with the canonical result\" unless metadata[\"success\"] == record[0]\n      if valid_success && metadata[\"metrics\"] != record[1]\n        return \"metadata metrics differ from the canonical result\"\n      end\n\n      execution_metadata_problem(id, metadata, success: valid_success)\n    rescue StandardError => e\n      \"metadata reconciliation failed (#{e.class}: #{e.message})\"\n    end\n\n    def execution_metadata_problem(id, metadata, success:)\n      executions = metadata[\"executions\"]\n      if metadata[\"timing_fixed\"] && metadata[\"build_success\"] == false\n        return \"a failed corrected-source build is marked successful\" if success\n        return \"a failed corrected-source build has executions\" unless executions == []\n        return nil\n      end\n      unless executions.is_a?(Array) && !executions.empty? && executions.all? { |entry| entry.is_a?(Hash) }\n        return \"execution metadata is missing or malformed\"\n      end\n      if metadata[\"timing_fixed\"] && metadata[\"build_success\"] != true\n        return \"corrected-source execution lacks a successful local build\"\n      end\n      executions.each do |entry|\n        return \"execution success is not boolean\" unless [true, false].include?(entry[\"success\"])\n        wall = entry[\"wall_seconds\"]\n        return \"execution wall time is invalid\" unless wall.is_a?(Numeric) && wall.to_f.finite? && !wall.negative?\n      end\n\n      labels = executions.map { |entry| entry[\"repetition\"] }\n      expected_walls = executions.drop(1).map { |entry| entry[\"wall_seconds\"] }\n      return \"measured wall times disagree with execution metadata\" unless metadata[\"wall_seconds\"] == expected_walls\n      return \"warmup wall time disagrees with execution metadata\" unless metadata[\"warmup_wall_seconds\"] == executions.first[\"wall_seconds\"]\n      unless metadata[\"all_execution_wall_seconds\"] == executions.map { |entry| entry[\"wall_seconds\"] }\n        return \"all-execution wall times disagree with execution metadata\"\n      end\n\n      if success\n        expected_labels = [\"warmup\", *(0...BENCHMARK_COUNT)]\n        return \"successful execution labels are not warmup followed by repetitions 0..4\" unless labels == expected_labels\n        return \"a successful canonical result contains a failed execution\" unless executions.all? { |entry| entry[\"success\"] }\n        return nil\n      end\n\n      partial_metrics = metadata[\"metrics\"]\n      unless partial_metrics.is_a?(Array) && partial_metrics.size < BENCHMARK_COUNT &&\n             partial_metrics.all? { |metrics| valid_metric_hash?(metrics) }\n        return \"failed-attempt partial metrics are malformed\"\n      end\n      warmup = executions.first\n      return \"failed execution metadata does not start with warmup\" unless labels.first == \"warmup\"\n      unless warmup[\"success\"]\n        return \"a failed warmup has unexpected measured repetitions\" unless executions.size == 1 && partial_metrics.empty?\n        return nil\n      end\n\n      measured = executions.drop(1)\n      return \"a successful warmup failure has no measured repetition\" if measured.empty?\n      return \"failed execution has too many repetitions\" if measured.size > BENCHMARK_COUNT\n      expected_labels = [\"warmup\", *(0...measured.size)]\n      return \"failed execution repetitions are not a contiguous prefix\" unless labels == expected_labels\n      return \"a non-final measured repetition failed\" unless measured[0...-1].all? { |entry| entry[\"success\"] }\n      unless partial_metrics.size == measured.size - 1\n        return \"partial metric count does not match completed repetitions\"\n      end\n      if measured.last[\"success\"]\n        parse_error = File.join(@benchmark_dir, id, \"#{BENCHMARK_OUT_PREFIX}#{measured.size - 1}_parse_error.log\")\n        return \"failed attempt has no failed execution or parse-error artifact\" unless File.file?(parse_error)\n      end\n      nil\n    end\n\n    def valid_metric_hash?(metrics)\n      return false unless metrics.is_a?(Hash) && metrics.key?(\"time\")\n      value = metrics[\"time\"]\n      BenchmarkMetrics.valid_time?(value)\n    end\n\n    def assert_config_consistency!(full_results)\n      metadata_path = File.join(@benchmark_dir, \"benchmark_run_metadata.yaml\")\n      if File.file?(metadata_path)\n        metadata = LocalEvaluation.load_yaml(metadata_path)\n        if metadata[\"configuration_sha256\"] != @config.digest\n          raise \"Existing benchmark results use configuration #{metadata['configuration_sha256']}, not #{@config.digest}\"\n        end\n      elsif !full_results.empty?\n        raise \"Benchmark metrics exist without configuration metadata; refusing to mix results\"\n      end\n      full_results.each_key do |id|\n        per_id = File.join(@benchmark_dir, id, \"benchmark_metadata.yaml\")\n        digest = LocalEvaluation.load_yaml(per_id)[\"configuration_sha256\"]\n        raise \"Benchmark #{id} uses a different configuration digest\" unless digest == @config.digest\n      end\n    end\n\n    def record_invocation(pending_count)\n      metadata_path = File.join(@benchmark_dir, \"benchmark_run_metadata.yaml\")\n      metadata = File.file?(metadata_path) ? LocalEvaluation.load_yaml(metadata_path) : {\n        \"created_at\" => Time.now.iso8601,\n        \"configuration\" => @config.path,\n        \"configuration_sha256\" => @config.digest,\n        \"manifest_sha256\" => LocalEvaluation.sha256_file(@manifest.path),\n        \"warmups\" => 1,\n        \"measurements\" => BENCHMARK_COUNT,\n        \"invocations\" => []\n      }\n      metadata[\"invocations\"] ||= []\n      metadata[\"invocations\"] << { \"started_at\" => Time.now.iso8601, \"selected\" => @selected.size,\n                                    \"pending\" => pending_count, \"retry_failed\" => @retry_failed,\n                                    \"pipeline_amendment_sha256\" => @pipeline_amendment&.digest,\n                                    \"source_correction_amendment_sha256\" => @source_correction&.digest }\n      metadata[\"pipeline_amendment_sha256\"] = @pipeline_amendment&.digest\n      metadata[\"source_correction_amendment_sha256\"] = @source_correction&.digest\n      LocalEvaluation.atomic_yaml(metadata_path, metadata)\n    end\n\n    def write_compatibility_results(full_results)\n      ordered = full_results.sort.to_h\n      LocalEvaluation.atomic_yaml(@full_results_path, ordered)\n      simple = ordered.to_h { |id, record| [id, record[0]] }\n      LocalEvaluation.atomic_yaml(@results_path, simple)\n    end\n\n    def benchmark_one(id, info)\n      benchmark = info.fetch(\"benchmark\")\n      par_type = info.fetch(\"par_type\")\n      cell = @config.cell(par_type, benchmark)\n      args = cell.fetch(\"args\").map(&:to_s)\n      timeout = cell.fetch(\"timeout_seconds\").to_i\n      output_dir = File.join(@benchmark_dir, id)\n      BuildSupport.archive_existing(output_dir, File.join(@benchmark_dir, \"attempts\", id))\n      FileUtils.mkdir_p(output_dir)\n      correction = @source_correction&.record_for(id)\n      return benchmark_corrected(id, info, args, timeout, output_dir, correction) if correction\n\n      executable = BuildSupport.find_executable(File.join(@run_dir, \"validation\", id), benchmark)\n      execute_benchmark(info, args, timeout, output_dir, executable)\n    end\n\n    def benchmark_corrected(id, info, args, timeout, output_dir, correction)\n      @source_correction.verify_record_source!(id)\n      workspace = Dir.mktmpdir(\"local-evaluation-timing-correction-\", \"/tmp\")\n      begin\n        unless File.realpath(workspace).start_with?(\"/tmp/\")\n          raise InfrastructureError, \"Corrected-source build workspace is not on local /tmp\"\n        end\n        stage_root = File.join(workspace, \"source\")\n        source_dir = BuildSupport.stage_source(\n          source_root: info.fetch(\"source_path\"), benchmark: info.fetch(\"benchmark\"), stage_root: stage_root\n        )\n        staging_metadata_path = File.join(workspace, \"source_staging.yaml\")\n        staging_metadata = LocalEvaluation.load_yaml(staging_metadata_path)\n        LocalEvaluation.atomic_yaml(File.join(output_dir, \"source_staging.yaml\"), staging_metadata)\n        build_dir = File.join(workspace, \"build\")\n        build_ok, build_error =    next\n        end\n        { \"id\" => id, \"benchmark\" => info.fetch(\"benchmark\"), \"model\" => info.fetch(\"model\"),\n          \"par_type\" => info.fetch(\"par_type\"), \"run\" => info.fetch(\"run\"),\n          \"source_batch\" => info.fetch(\"batch\"), \"source_prefix\" => prefix,\n          \"metric_label\" => METRIC_LABELS.fetch(info.fetch(\"benchmark\")),\n          \"benchmark_median_time_ms\" => nil, \"overall_score\" => nil, \"benchmark_config_sha256\" => nil,\n          \"validation_metadata_sha256\" => TimingAudit.sha256_file(metadata_path) }\n      end\n      excluded_path = File.join(@output_dir, \"excluded.jsonl\")\n      TimingAudit.atomic_write(excluded_path, TimingAudit.dump_jsonl(excluded))\n      generated = { \"commit\" => source.fetch(\"commit\"),\n                    \"repository\" => TimingAudit.capture!(\"git\", \"-C\", @source_root, \"remote\", \"get-url\", \"origin\").strip }\n      [generated, dataset_path, records,\n       { \"parallelization_types\" => %w[mpi hybrid], \"validation_status\" => 5,\n         \"benchmark_success\" => nil, \"basis\" => \"validation_only\", \"validation_records\" => results.size },\n       { \"validation_run\" => @validation_run, \"evaluation_manifest_sha256\" => manifest_digest,\n         \"excluded_sha256\" => TimingAudit.sha256_file(excluded_path) }]\n    end\n\n    def selected_rows(dataset_path)\n      source_prefixes = {}\n      records = CSV.foreach(dataset_path, headers: true).filter_map do |row|\n        next unless %w[mpi hybrid].include?(row.fetch(\"par_type\"))\n        next unless row.fetch(\"validation_status\").to_i == 5\n        next unless row.fetch(\"benchmark_success\") == \"true\"\n\n        source_path = File.expand_path(row.fetch(\"source_path\"))\n        relative = Pathname.new(source_path).relative_path_from(Pathname.new(@source_root)).to_s\n        raise \"Source escapes generated repository: relative\n        benchmark = row.fetch(\"benchmark\")\n        {\n          \"id\" => id,\n          \"benchmark\" => benchmark,\n          \"model\" => row.fetch(\"model\"),\n          \"par_type\" => row.fetch(\"par_type\"),\n          \"run\" => row.fetch(\"run\").to_i,\n          \"source_batch\" => row.fetch(\"source_batch\"),\n          \"source_prefix\" => relative,\n          \"metric_label\" => METRIC_LABELS.fetch(benchmark),\n          \"benchmark_median_time_ms\" => row.fetch(\"benchmark_median_time\").to_f,\n          \"overall_score\" => row.fetch(\"overall_score\").to_i,\n          \"benchmark_config_sha256\" => row.fetch(\"benchmark_config_sha256\")\n        }\n      end\n      raise \"Expected selected audit records\" if records.empty?\n      records.sort_by { |record| record.fetch(\"id\") }\n    end\n  end\n\n  class TrialSelector\n    def initialize(records, size)\n      @records = records\n      @size = [Integer(size), records.size].min\n    end\n\n    def select\n      selected = []\n      pilot = @records.find { |record| record.fetch(\"id\") == KNOWN_INVALID_PILOT }\n      selected << pilot if pilot\n\n      while selected.size < @size\n        remaining = @records - selected\n        candidate = remaining.min_by { |record| selection_key(record, selected) }\n        selected << candidate\n      end\n      selected.map { |record| record.fetch(\"id\") }\n    end\n\n    private\n\n    def selection_key(record, selected)\n      features = record.fetch(\"static_features\")\n      max_group = features.fetch(\"has_mpi_max\") ? \"max\" : \"no-max\"\n      [\n        selected.count { |entry| entry.fetch(\"benchmark\") == record.fetch(\"benchmark\") },\n        selected.count { |entry| entry.fetch(\"par_type\") == record.fetch(\"par_type\") },\n        selected.count do |entry|\n          (entry.fetch(\"static_features\").fetch(\"has_mpi_max\") ? \"max\" : \"no-max\") == max_group\n        end,\n        selected.count { |entry| entry.fetch(\"model\") == record.fetch(\"model\") },\n        record.fetch(\"overall_score\").to_i >= 9 ? 0 : 1,\n        Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(record.fetch(\"id\"))\n      ]\n    end\n  end\n\n  class ResultValidator\n    def initialize(records)\n      @records = records.to_h { |record| [record.fetch(\"id\"), record] }\n    end\n\n    def validate!(result, expected_id:)\n      raise \"Result is not an object\" unless result.is_a?(Hash)\n      missing = REQUIRED_RESULT_KEYS - result.keys\n      extra = result.keys - REQUIRED_RESULT_KEYS\n      raise \"Missing result keys: #{missing.join(', ')}\" unless missing.empty?\n      raise \"Unexpected result keys: #{extra.join(', ')}\" unless extra.empty?\n      raise \"Program ID mismatch: #{result['program_id'].inspect}\" unless result.fetch(\"program_id\") == expected_id\n      raise \"Invalid verdict\" unless VERDICTS.include?(result.fetch(\"verdict\"))\n      raise \"Invalid confidence\" unless CONFIDENCES.include?(result.fetch(\"confidence\"))\n\n      categories = result.fetch(\"issue_categories\")\n      raise \"issue_categories must be a non-empty unique array\" unless categories.is_a?(Array) && !categories.empty? && categories.uniq == categories\n      unknown = categories - ISSUE_CATEGORIES\n      raise \"Unknown issue categories: #{unknown.join(', ')}\" unless unknown.empty?\n      if result.fetch(\"verdict\") == \"valid\"\n        raise \"Valid result must use only the none category\" unless categories == [\"none\"]\n        raise \"Valid result cannot request a timing fix\" unless result.fetch(\"timing_only_fix_possible\") == false\n        raise \"Valid result must have an empty minimal_fix\" unless result.fetch(\"minimal_fix\") == \"\"\n      elsif categories.include?(\"none\")\n        raise \"Non-valid result cannot use the none category\"\n      end\n\n      %w[timed_region start_synchronization stop_synchronization rank_aggregation reported_value].each do |key|\n        raise \"#{key} must be non-empty text\" unless result[key].is_a?(String) && !result[key].strip.empty?\n      end\n      %w[semantic_equivalence_basis minimal_fix notes].each do |key|\n        raise \"#{key} must be text\" unless result[key].is_a?(String)\n      end\n      unless [true, false].include?(result.fetch(\"timing_only_fix_possible\"))\n        raise \"timing_only_fix_possible must be boolean\"\n      end\n\n      record = @records.fetch(expected_id)\n      line_counts = record.fetch(\"source_files\").to_h { |file| [file.fetch(\"path\"), file.fetch(\"lines\")] }\n      evidence = result.fetch(\"evidence\")\n      raise \"Evidence must be a non-empty array\" unless evidence.is_a?(Array) && !evidence.empty?\n      evidence.each do |entry|\n        raise \"Evidence entry must be an object\" unless entry.is_a?(Hash)\n        raise \"Evidence keys are invalid\" unless entry.keys.sort == %w[finding lines path]\n        path = entry.fetch(\"path\")\n        maximum = line_counts.fetch(path) { raise \"Evidence cites unavailable path #{path.inspect}\" }\n        match = /\\A(\\d+)(?:-(\\d+))?\\z/.match(entry.fetch(\"lines\").to_s)\n        raise \"Invalid evidence line range\" unless match\n        first = match[1].to_i\n        last = (match[2] || match[1]).to_i\n        raise \"Invalid evidence line order\" unless first.positive? && last >= first\n        raise \"Evidence line #{last} exceeds #{path} line count #{maximum}\" if last > maximum\n        raise \"Evidence finding must be non-empty\" unless entry.fetch(\"finding\").is_a?(String) && !entry.fetch(\"finding\").strip.empty?\n      end\n      true\n    end\n  end\n\n  class CodexCommand\n    attr_reader :model, :effort\n\n    def initialize(model:, effort:)\n      @model = model\n      @effort = effort\n    end\n\n    def argv(schema_path:, output_path:)\n      command = [\n        \"codex\", \"exec\",\n        \"--model\", @model,\n        \"--config\", %(model_reasoning_effort=\"#{@effort}\"),\n        \"--config\", 'approval_policy=\"never\"',\n        \"--config\", 'web_search=\"disabled\"',\n        \"--sandbox\", \"read-only\",\n        \"--ephemeral\",\n        \"--ignore-user-config\",\n        \"--strict-config\",\n        \"--skip-git-repo-check\",\n        \"--output-schema\", schema_path,\n        \"--output-last-message\", output_path,\n        \"--json\",\n        \"--color\", \"never\"\n      ]\n      DISABLED_FEATURES.each { |feature| command.concat([\"--disable\", feature]) }\n      command << \"-\"\n      command\n    end\n  end\n\n  class AuditRunner\n    def initialize(output_dir:, scope:, jobs:, model: DEFAULT_MODEL, effort: DEFAULT_EFFORT,\n                   timeout: DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, retries: DEFAULT_RETRIES, only_ids: [])\n      @output_dir = File.realpath(output_dir)\n      @scope = scope.to_s\n      raise \"Scope must be trial or full\" unless %w[trial full].include?(@scope)\n      @jobs = Integer(jobs)\n      raise \"Jobs must be positive\" unless @jobs.positive?\n      @model = model\n      @effort = effort\n      @timeout = Integer(timeout)\n      @retries = Integer(retries)\n      @only_ids = Array(only_ids).map(&:to_s)\n      raise \"Timeout and retries must be positive\" unless @timeout.positive? && @retries.positive?\n\n      @manifest = YAML.safe_load(File.read(File.join(@output_dir, \"manifest.yaml\")), aliases: false)\n      @records = TimingAudit.load_jsonl(File.join(@output_dir, \"inventory.jsonl\"))\n      @records_by_id = @records.to_h { |record| [record.fetch(\"id\"), record] }\n      @validator = ResultValidator.new(@records)\n      @verifier = AuditVerifier.new(@output_dir, @scope)\n      generated = @manifest.fetch(\"generated_source\")\n      @repository = SourceRepository.new(root: generated.fetch(\"root\"), commit: generated.fetch(\"commit\"))\n      @template = File.read(File.join(@output_dir, \"prompt-template.txt\"))\n      @schema_path = File.join(@output_dir, \"result-schema.json\")\n      verify_artifact_hashes!\n      @command = CodexCommand.new(model: @model, effort: @effort)\n      @mutex = Mutex.new\n      @completed_this_run = 0\n      @failures = []\n    end\n\n    def run\n      ids = selected_ids\n      pending = ids.reject { |id| valid_existing_result?(id) }\n      puts \"Timing audit #{@scope}: #{ids.size} selected, #{ids.size - pending.size} complete, #{pending.size} pending, #{@jobs} workers\"\n      update_progress(ids)\n      queue = Queue.new\n      pending.each { |id| queue << id }\n      @jobs.times { queue << nil }\n\n      workers = @jobs.times.map do |worker_index|\n        Thread.new do\n          while (id = queue.pop)\n            begin\n              run_with_retries(id, worker_index + 1)\n            rescue Exception => error\n              @mutex.synchronize do\n                @failures << [id, error]\n                warn \"FAILED #{id}: #{error.class}: #{error.message}\"\n              end\n            ensure\n              update_progress(ids)\n            end\n          end\n        end\n      end\n      workers.each(&:join)\n      unless @failures.empty?\n        details = @failures.map { |id, error| \"#{id}: #{error.class}: #{error.message}\" }.join(\"\\n\")\n        raise \"#{@failures.size} audit jobs failed after retries:\\n#{details}\"\n      end\n\n      if ids.sort == scope_ids.sort\n        AuditVerifier.new(@output_dir, @scope).run\n      else\n        puts \"Completed and validated requested subset: #{ids.size} record(s)\"\n      end\n    end\n\n    private\n\n    def selected_ids\n      ids = scope_ids\n      return ids if @only_ids.empty?\n\n      unknown = @only_ids - ids\n      raise \"Requested IDs are outside #{@scope} scope: #{unknown.join(', ')}\" unless unknown.empty?\n      @only_ids\n    end\n\n    def scope_ids\n      return @records.map { |record| record.fetch(\"id\") } if @scope == \"full\"\n\n      File.readlines(File.join(@output_dir, \"trial-ids.txt\"), chomp: true).reject(&:empty?)\n    end\n\n    def verify_artifact_hashes!\n      artifacts = @manifest.fetch(\"artifacts\")\n      paths = {\n        \"prompt_template_sha256\" => File.join(@output_dir, \"prompt-template.txt\"),\n        \"result_schema_sha256\" => @schema_path,\n        \"runner_sha256\" => File.join(@output_dir, \"runner-snapshot.rb\")\n      }\n      { \"inventory_sha256\" => \"inventory.jsonl\", \"trial_ids_sha256\" => \"trial-ids.txt\" }.each do |key, name|\n        paths[key] = File.join(@output_dir, name) if artifacts.key?(key)\n      end\n      paths.each do |key, path|\n        actual = TimingAudit.sha256_file(path)\n        raise \"Audit artifact digest mismatch for #{path}\" unless actual == artifacts.fetch(key)\n      end\n      current_runner = TimingAudit.sha256_file(__FILE__)\n      unless current_runner == artifacts.fetch(\"runner_sha256\")\n        raise \"Current timing-audit runner differs from the prepared immutable snapshot\"\n      end\n    end\n\n    def valid_existing_result?(id)\n      path = result_path(id)\n      return false unless File.file?(path)\n      @verifier.verify_result!(id, JSON.parse(File.read(path)))\n    rescue StandardError => error\n      warn \"Ignoring invalid existing result #{id}: #{error.message}\"\n      false\n    end\n\n    def run_with_retries(id, worker)\n      record = @records_by_id.fetch(id)\n      prompt = build_prompt(record)\n      raise \"Prompt exceeds #{MAX_PROMPT_BYTES} bytes for #{id}\" if prompt.bytesize > MAX_PROMPT_BYTES\n      last_error = nil\n      previous_attempts = Dir[File.join(@output_dir, \"logs\", id, \"attempt-*\")].map { |path| File.basename(path).delete_prefix(\"attempt-\").to_i }\n      first_attempt = previous_attempts.max.to_i + 1\n      @retries.times do |offset|\n        attempt = first_attempt + offset\n        begin\n          run_attempt(record, prompt, attempt, worker)\n          @mutex.synchronize do\n            @completed_this_run += 1\n            puts format(\"[%d] complete %s (%d new)\", worker, id, @completed_this_run)\n          end\n          return\n        rescue Exception => error\n          last_error = error\n          @mutex.synchronize { warn \"[#{worker}] attempt #{attempt}/#{@retries} failed for #{id}: #{error.message}\" }\n          sleep([2**(offset + 1), 20].min + rand) if offset + 1 < @retries\n        end\n      end\n      raise last_error\n    end\n\n    def build_prompt(record)\n      dossier = @repository.dossier(record)\n      @template % {\n        program_id: record.fetch(\"id\"),\n        benchmark: record.fetch(\"benchmark\"),\n        par_type: record.fetch(\"par_type\"),\n        metric_label: record.fetch(\"metric_label\"),\n        dossier: dossier\n      }\n    end\n\n    def run_attempt(record, prompt, attempt, worker)\n      id = record.fetch(\"id\")\n      attempt_dir = File.join(@output_dir, \"logs\", id, format(\"attempt-%02d\", attempt))\n      FileUtils.mkdir_p(attempt_dir)\n      stdout_path = File.join(attempt_dir, \"events.jsonl\")\n      stderr_path = File.join(attempt_dir, \"stderr.log\")\n      metadata_path = File.join(attempt_dir, \"metadata.yaml\")\n      started_at = TimingAudit.utc_now\n      started = TimingAudit.monotonic_now\n      status = nil\n      timed_out = false\n\n      Dir.mktmpdir(\"llm-timing-audit-\") do |temporary_dir|\n        last_message = File.join(temporary_dir, \"last-message.json\")\n        argv = @command.argv(schema_path: @schema_path, output_path: last_message)\n        Tempfile.create([\"timing-audit-prompt-\", \".txt\"], temporary_dir) do |input|\n          input.binmode\n          input.write(prompt)\n          input.flush\n          input.rewind\n          File.open(stdout_path, \"wb\") do |stdout|\n            File.open(stderr_path, \"wb\") do |stderr|\n              pid = Process.spawn(*argv, in: input, out: stdout, err: stderr,\n                                  chdir: temporary_dir, pgroup: true, rlimit_core: [0, 0])\n              loop do\n                waited, status = Process.wait2(pid, Process::WNOHANG)\n                break if waited\n                if TimingAudit.monotonic_now - started >= @timeout\n                  timed_out = true\n                  terminate_group(pid)\n                  _waited, status = Process.wait2(pid)\n                  break\n                end\n                sleep 0.2\n              end\n            end\n          end\n        end\n\n        wall = TimingAudit.monotonic_now - started\n        metadata = {\n          \"program_id\" => id,\n          \"worker\" => worker,\n          \"attempt\" => attempt,\n          \"started_at\" => started_at,\n          \"finished_at\" => TimingAudit.utc_now,\n          \"wall_seconds\" => wall,\n          \"timed_out\" => timed_out,\n          \"exit_code\" => status&.exitstatus,\n          \"term_signal\" => status&.termsig,\n          \"model\" => @model,\n          \"reasoning_effort\" => @effort,\n          \"prompt_sha256\" => TimingAudit.sha256_bytes(prompt),\n          \"prompt_bytes\" => prompt.bytesize,\n          \"source_digest\" => record.fetch(\"source_digest\"),\n          \"source_tree_oid\" => record.fetch(\"source_tree_oid\"),\n          \"events_sha256\" => TimingAudit.sha256_file(stdout_path),\n          \"stderr_sha256\" => TimingAudit.sha256_file(stderr_path),\n          \"usage\" => File.foreach(stdout_path).filter_map { |line|\n            event = JSON.parse(line) rescue nil\n            event && event[\"type\"] == \"turn.completed\" ? event[\"usage\"] : nil\n          }.last,\n          \"diagnostics\" => TimingAudit.load_jsonl(stdout_path).filter_map { |event|\n            item = event[\"item\"]\n            item[\"message\"] if item && item[\"type\"] == \"error\"\n          },\n          \"runner_sha256\" => @manifest.fetch(\"artifacts\").fetch(\"runner_sha256\")\n        }\n        TimingAudit.atomic_write(metadata_path, YAML.dump(metadata))\n        raise \"Codex invocation timed out after #{@timeout}s\" if timed_out\n        raise \"Codex exited #{status&.exitstatus || 'without status'}\" unless status&.success?\n        raise \"Codex did not write its last message\" unless File.file?(last_message)\n        TimingAudit.verify_static_events!(stdout_path)\n\n        raw = File.read(last_message)\n        result = JSON.parse(raw)\n        @validator.validate!(result, expected_id: id)\n        serialized = JSON.pretty_generate(result) + \"\\n\"\n        metadata[\"result_sha256\"] = TimingAudit.sha256_bytes(serialized)\n        metadata[\"static_only_verified\"] = true\n        TimingAudit.atomic_write(metadata_path, YAML.dump(metadata))\n        TimingAudit.atomic_write(result_path(id), serialized)\n      end\n    end\n\n    def terminate_group(pid)\n      Process.kill(\"TERM\", -pid)\n      deadline = TimingAudit.monotonic_now + 5\n      while TimingAudit.monotonic_now < deadline\n        begin\n          Process.kill(0, -pid)\n        rescue Errno::ESRCH\n          return\n        end\n        sleep 0.1\n      end\n      Process.kill(\"KILL\", -pid)\n    rescue Errno::ESRCH\n      nil\n    end\n\n    def result_path(id)\n      File.join(@output_dir, \"results\", \"#{id}.json\")\n    end\n\n    def update_progress(ids)\n      @mutex.synchronize do\n        complete = ids.count { |id| File.file?(result_path(id)) }\n        progress = {\n          \"updated_at\" => TimingAudit.utc_now,\n          \"scope\" => @scope,\n          \"selected\" => ids.size,\n          \"complete\" => complete,\n          \"pending\" => ids.size - complete,\n          \"failures_this_run\" => @failures.size\n        }\n        TimingAudit.atomic_write(File.join(@output_dir, \"progress-#{@scope}.yaml\"), YAML.dump(progress))\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  class AuditVerifier\n    def initialize(output_dir, scope)\n      @output_dir = File.realpath(output_dir)\n      @scope = scope.to_s\n      raise \"Scope must be trial or full\" unless %w[trial full].include?(@scope)\n      @records = TimingAudit.load_jsonl(File.join(@output_dir, \"inventory.jsonl\"))\n      @records_by_id = @records.to_h { |record| [record.fetch(\"id\"), record] }\n      raise \"Duplicate inventory IDs\" unless @records_by_id.size == @records.size\n      manifest = YAML.safe_load_file(File.join(@output_dir, \"manifest.yaml\"), aliases: false)\n      raise \"Inventory count mismatch\" unless manifest.dig(\"selection\", \"records\") == @records.size\n      { \"inventory_sha256\" => \"inventory.jsonl\", \"trial_ids_sha256\" => \"trial-ids.txt\" }.each do |key, name|\n        expected = manifest.dig(\"artifacts\", key)\n        raise \"Inventory digest mismatch for #{name}\" if expected && expected != TimingAudit.sha256_file(File.join(@output_dir, name))\n      end\n      @validator = ResultValidator.new(@records)\n    end\n\n    def run(write_summary: true)\n      ids = if @scope == \"trial\"\n        File.readlines(File.join(@output_dir, \"trial-ids.txt\"), chomp: true).reject(&:empty?)\n      else\n        @records.map { |record| record.fetch(\"id\") }\n      end\n      results = ids.map do |id|\n        path = File.join(@output_dir, \"results\", \"#{id}.json\")\n        raise \"Missing result #{id}\" unless File.file?(path)\n        result = JSON.parse(File.read(path))\n        verify_result!(id, result)\n        result\n      end\n      write_summary(results) if write_summary\n      counts = results.group_by { |result| result.fetch(\"verdict\") }.transform_values(&:size)\n      puts \"Verified #{@scope} timing audit: #{results.size} records (#{VERDICTS.map { |v| \"#{v}=#{counts.fetch(v, 0)}\" }.join(', ')})\"\n      if @scope == \"trial\"\n        pilot = results.find { |result| result.fetch(\"program_id\") == KNOWN_INVALID_PILOT }\n        if @records_by_id.key?(KNOWN_INVALID_PILOT)\n          raise \"Known pilot was not selected\" unless pilot\n          raise \"Known invalid pilot was classified #{pilot.fetch('verdict')}\" unless pilot.fetch(\"verdict\") == \"invalid\"\n        end\n        puts \"Trial requires source-grounded quality review before expanding to the full inventory.\"\n      end\n      true\n    end\n\n    def verify_result!(id, result)\n      @validator.validate!(result, expected_id: id)\n      path = File.join(@output_dir, \"results\", \"#{id}.json\")\n      attempts = Dir[File.join(@output_dir, \"logs\", id, \"attempt-*\", \"metadata.yaml\")]\n      accepted = attempts.any? do |metadata_path|\n        metadata = YAML.safe_load_file(metadata_path, aliases: false)\n        next false unless metadata[\"exit_code\"] == 0 && !metadata[\"timed_out\"]\n        event_path = File.join(File.dirname(metadata_path), \"events.jsonl\")\n        if metadata.key?(\"result_sha256\")\n          next false unless metadata[\"result_sha256\"] == TimingAudit.sha256_file(path)\n        else\n          # Legacy audit evidence has no explicit response digest. Match the\n          # actual JSON response rather than trusting only the exit status.\n          messages = TimingAudit.load_jsonl(event_path).filter_map do |event|\n            item = event[\"item\"]\n            next unless event[\"type\"] == \"item.completed\" && item && item[\"type\"] == \"agent_message\"\n            JSON.parse(item[\"text\"]) rescue nil\n          end\n          next false unless messages.last == result\n        end\n        if metadata[\"events_sha256\"] && metadata[\"events_sha256\"] != TimingAudit.sha256_file(event_path)\n          raise \"Audit event digest mismatch for #{id}\"\n        end\n        unless metadata[\"source_digest\"] == @records_by_id.fetch(id).fetch(\"source_digest\")\n          raise \"Audit attempt source mismatch for #{id}\"\n        end\n        TimingAudit.verify_static_events!(event_path)\n      end\n      raise \"No verified static-only attempt for #{id}\" unless accepted\n      true\n    end\n\n    private\n\n    def write_summary(results)\n      enriched = results.map do |result|\n        record = @records_by_id.fetch(result.fetch(\"program_id\"))\n        {\n          \"program_id\" => result.fetch(\"program_id\"),\n          \"benchmark\" => record.fetch(\"benchmark\"),\n          \"model\" => record.fetch(\"model\"),\n          \"par_type\" => record.fetch(\"par_type\"),\n          \"run\" => record.fetch(\"run\"),\n          \"overall_score\" => record.fetch(\"overall_score\"),\n          \"benchmark_median_time_ms\" => record.fetch(\"benchmark_median_time_ms\"),\n          \"source_tree_oid\" => record.fetch(\"source_tree_oid\"),\n          \"source_digest\" => record.fetch(\"source_digest\"),\n          \"verdict\" => result.fetch(\"verdict\"),\n The audit prompt says the common pattern is NOT by itself equivalent—but it might be accepted if the barriers bracket all work.
